_comment: Maps in-game building names that share function (sub-menus, layout) to a canonical building slug. The layout-lookup loader applies these aliases before looking up files in scene_layouts/buildings/, so different in-game names that share function reference the same canonical layout file without manual duplication.
_added_2026_05_13: Initial seed based on user-confirmed function-groups: palace/castle, cathedral/temple/sanctuary/church.  Add more entries as new aliases are observed.
